title: Slow, buggy
body:
Good idea, sloppy product.

+ It's good you can attach text and pictures.
- Interface is alright, but buggy, and app crashes from time to time.
- Cannot sync files elsewhere or even see files in Google Drive, as far as I can tell. So... What's the point, then? I'm locked inside this app. Maybe if you want to create really meaningless notes and not actually "keep" them and archive them. Maybe this is usable for grocety shopping lists and the like, but there are far better apps out there for that.
- Wanted to add really long text files (chat logs), but couldn't open them. App was slow and would crash. These are still only text files and should always open just fine. But no. Forced formatting doesn't help.

For text only (and Markdown), I suggest to look for Notesy or Jottings.
For richer notes, maybe just use iOS' own Notes. Or even Evernote, if it works for you.
